meta.title: Delete sessions (dsh-session-purge)
meta.description: Adds a "Delete sessions" entry above the workspace list in the sidebar. It lists every session of the workspace, supports click-to-select / click-again-to-deselect and a select-all button in the top-right, with the delete button in the bottom-right. Deleting moves sessions to a recycle bin that restores them byte-for-byte; purging from there erases the session logs, projection cache, session policy, workspace registration and related cost entries, plus the attachments only those sessions referenced.
